column1: # Lonapse 0.6.0 lines (im_). Written as drafts, converted to this table.

column14: ¿Tú sabes para qué sirve este botón?
column15: Do you know what this button does?

column14: Ha sido sin querer. Estaba nadando.
column15: It was an accident. I was swimming.
That's why I swim so badly.

column14: Dile que baje la voz. La nave escucha.
column15: Tell it to keep it down. The ship is listening.

column14: Esa es la peor excusa que he oído.
column15: That's the worst excuse I've ever heard.
All the spots are the same.
But this one smells like me.

column14: El que tenga tienda de galletas.
column15: The one with a cookie shop.

column14: Pues alguien ha roncado toda la noche.
Creo que me he dejado la llave de casa en el traje de entreno.
column15: I think I left my house key in the training suit.

column14: ¿Y cómo vas a entrar al volver?
column15: So how will you get in when we're back?

column14: Por la ventana. Ya soy astronauta.
column15: Through the window. I'm an astronaut now.

column14: Mira, una nube con forma de cohete.
column15: Look, a cloud shaped like a rocket.

column14: Estamos encima de las nubes. Todas parecen nubes.
column15: We're above the clouds. They all look like clouds.
It's already floating. Catch it yourself.

column14: No preguntes eso cada cinco minutos.
column15: Don't ask that every five minutes.

column14: ¿Y si pintamos la nave de rosa?
column15: What if we paint the ship pink?
Do you also dream that you're falling?
Right. That's why I can't sleep.

column14: Has vuelto a dejar la tapa abierta.
column15: You left the lid open again.

column14: La de la pasta de dientes. Está en mi pelo.
column15: The toothpaste one. It's in my hair.

column14: Te apuesto un postre a que llego al otro lado sin tocar nada.
column15: I bet you a dessert I can reach the other side without touching anything.
So I don't wake the rocket.
This one does. I can hear it breathing.

column14: Aquí no se puede. Es el aire.
column15: It doesn't work up here. It's the air.
I used it as a pillow.

column14: Creo que he crecido un poco.
column15: I think I grew a bit.

column14: Qué pena. Pensé que era el brócoli.
column15: Shame. I thought it was the broccoli.

column14: ¿Crees que hay alguien más ahí fuera?
column15: Do you think anyone else is out there?

column14: Espero que sí. Y que tengan cafetería.
column15: I hope so. And that they have a cafeteria.
If we get lost, who do we call?
And if Control gets lost too?
Then we all look for each other.

column14: No mires, pero creo que te sigue un guante.
column15: Don't look, but I think a glove is following you.

column14: ¿Otra vez? Es el mío. Me quiere mucho.
column15: Again? It's mine. It loves me.

column14: No puede ser. Me lavé la semana pasada.
column15: Can't be. I washed last week.

column14: Aquella vez que vomitaste en la centrifugadora.
column15: That time you threw up in the centrifuge.

column14: He hecho una lista de cosas que quiero hacer al volver.
column15: I made a list of things I want to do when we're back.

column14: ¿Por qué los cohetes van al colegio?
column15: Why do rockets go to school?
Why do you have three watches?

column14: Uno para aquí, uno para casa, y uno por si acaso.
column15: One for here, one for home, and one just in case.
Why are you looking at me like that?

column14: Tienes una miga en la nariz.
column15: You have a crumb on your nose.

column14: Ya no. Se ha ido flotando.

column15: If you were a planet, which one would you be?

column14: Yo uno con anillos. Para ir elegante.
column15: I'd be one with rings. To look fancy.

column14: Te cambio mi postre por tu turno de guardia.
column15: I'll trade my dessert for your watch shift.

column14: El que ya me he comido.
Creo que la nave me está hablando.
column15: I think the ship is talking to me.
Have you written to your family?

column14: Sí. Les he dicho que aquí hace frío.
column15: Yes. I told them it's cold here.

column14: Quería que se preocuparan un poco.
column15: I wanted them to worry a little.
How many days have we been here?

column14: ¿Tú crees que Control nos escucha ahora?
column15: Do you think Control is listening now?

column14: Entonces puedo decirlo: el café de Control es horrible.
column15: Then I can say it: Control's coffee is awful.
Can you help me with the suit?

column14: Aquí arriba, todo cuenta como desayuno.
column15: Up here, everything counts as breakfast.

column14: ¿Te has dado cuenta de que aquí no se puede tropezar?
column15: Did you notice you can't trip up here?

column14: Tú lo has hecho tres veces.
Yo echo de menos las sillas.
Yo echo de menos el suelo.
Yo no echo de menos nada. Aquí estoy genial.
column15: I don't miss anything. I'm great here.

column14: Ese lápiz tiene que ser un espía.
column15: That pencil must be a spy.
It makes a sun face at me.

column14: Me pica la nariz y estoy atado al asiento.
column15: My nose itches and I'm strapped in.

column14: ¿Tú crees que las estrellas nos ven?
column15: Do you think the stars can see us?

column14: Si nos ven, que no se rían.
column15: If they can, I hope they don't laugh.

column14: Me he despertado pegado al techo.
column15: I woke up stuck to the ceiling.

column14: Ha sido la mejor noche de mi vida.
Te reto a no hablar en diez minutos.
column15: I dare you not to talk for ten minutes.

column14: Creo que he visto un pájaro.
column15: I think I saw a bird.

column14: No hay pájaros en el espacio.
column15: There are no birds in space.

column14: Entonces era un pájaro muy valiente.
column15: Then it was a very brave bird.
If we meet aliens, what do we say?

column14: No lo sé. Pero no lo toques.
column15: No idea. But don't touch it.

column14: ¿Sabes lo que me gusta del espacio?
column15: You know what I like about space?

column14: Que nadie me pide que saque la basura.
column15: Nobody asks me to take out the trash.

column14: La basura está flotando detrás de ti.
column15: The trash is floating behind you.
Did you bring anything to read?
When we're back, will they give us a medal?
Why do I have four arms?

column14: ¿Tú cuántas veces has ido al espacio?
column15: How many times have you been to space?
Then let go of my hand.
Did you turn off the oven at home?
Why are there so many buttons?

column14: ¿Te has fijado? Cada hora es de día y de noche.
column15: Have you noticed? Every hour it's day and night.

column14: Por eso tengo tanto sueño y tanta hambre.
column15: That's why I'm so sleepy and so hungry.

column14: Desde aquí arriba no se ven las fronteras.
column15: You can't see any borders from up here.
How many laps have we done?

column14: He perdido la cuenta en la tercera.
column15: I lost count at the third.
I lost it at the second.

column14: Mira, ahí abajo está nuestra casa.
column15: Look, there's our home down there.
The blue one. The big one. All of it.
Windows with something to look at?

column14: A quién aguanta más sin mirar la ventana.
column15: Who can go longest without looking out the window.

column14: Lo mismo que hace una hora, menos una hora.
column15: Same as an hour ago, minus an hour.

column14: El suelo se ve muy blando.
Se parece a casa, pero sin casa.
column15: It looks like home, but without the home.
